$comment: The gates skill_eval.py runs, in order (plan.md:845). live: the gates of check_live_gates, which every --live start, every loop iteration and the plan display run; post_builder: the checks loop runs after each builder call. skill_eval.LIVE_GATES and POST_BUILDER_GATES must hold exactly these ids in this order: plan prints any difference, and check_live_gates and loop refuse. Part of the rule bundle hash (ruleset_sha256).
